stations_source.citation: Menne, Matthew J., Imke Durre, Bryant Korzeniewski, Shelley McNeill, Kristy Thomas, Xungang Yin, Steven Anthony, Ron Ray, Russell S. Vose, Byron E.Gleason, and Tamara G. Houston (2012): Global Historical Climatology Network - Daily (GHCN-Daily), Version 3. Daily minimum temperature (TMIN), stations outside the United States, 1991-2020. NOAA National Climatic Data Center. doi:10.7289/V5D21VHZ. Accessed 2026-10-20.
stations_source.method: frost winters at each station outside the US: the twelve months centred on its coldest month, inside 1991-2020; a winter counts when each of its three coldest months holds 20 or more quality-passed daily lows, and is a frost winter with a night at or below 0.0 C; a station counts with 10 or more such winters
stations_source.source: NOAA NCEI Global Historical Climatology Network - Daily (GHCN-Daily), by_year files, TMIN
